name: pria-tools
description: Pria agentic-VM in-VM tool extension: search_knowledge (RAG/KAG vault search), search_history (conversation history), and save_to_vault (WRITE a document into the IP vault, into a chosen folder, indexed — dry-run by default). Calls Praxis's Capability Gateway, machine-token authenticated.

config.description: Pria API base URL. Defaults to https://pria.praxislxp.com.
Pria API key (pria_<40 hex chars>). Prefer PRIA_API_KEY env var.
Capability Gateway v2 machine token. Prefer the PRIA_AGENT_TOOL_TOKEN env var.
